run_precompute_enumerate_surface: run the script to enumerate and pickle surface structures for a bulk crystal from a database
create_enumerate_surfaces_for_saving: create a function that enumerates all symmetrically distinct surfaces of a bulk structure up to a max Miller index
build_standardize_bulk: build a function that standardizes a bulk unit cell to its conventional standard structure using spacegroup analysis
test_is_structure_invertible: test whether a pymatgen Structure has z-direction symmetry by checking its spacegroup affine transformation matrices
refactor_flip_struct: refactor a pymatgen Structure by flipping it upside down using 180-degree x-axis rotation and cell normalization
